## Checklist

- [ ] Targets the **`develop`** branch
- [ ] `mvn -o test` passes locally (suite is green)
- [ ] New/changed behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] Commit messages follow **Conventional Commits**
- [ ] `git status` is clean — **no new source files left untracked**
- [ ] New source files carry the **Apache-2.0 license header**
- [ ] README / docs updated if the **REST API (`/api/v1`)** or user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] No breaking change to the `/api/v1` contract (or it is called out and justified below)
